meta.title: Xanguine — Websites Built by a Small Team, Directly
meta.description: Xanguine builds websites for small businesses worldwide from Portugal, and is hiring salespeople to grow the team.

hero.intro: No faceless platform, no confusing dashboards, no ticket numbers. Xanguine designs and builds websites, online shops and booking systems with a real person on the other end, from a single stylist in a salon to a hotel chain that needs booking management. We work on Shopify too.
hero.carouselLabel: Photos of happy small business owners

scale.title: One person or one hundred locations.
scale.intro: We work on any scale. Whether you cut hair in a single chair or run a chain of hotels, we build the website and booking tools that fit how you actually work.

cards.label: One person
cards.title: The solo stylist
cards.text: A clean website with online booking, your services and prices, and a gallery of your work. Up and running quickly, easy for you to edit.

cards.label: A growing team
cards.title: Shops, clinics and studios
cards.text: Product catalogues, enquiry flows and scheduling for businesses with a handful of staff and a steady stream of customers.

cards.label: Many locations
cards.title: Hotels and chains
cards.text: Booking management across properties: availability, rates, reservations and a single place to run it all.

scale.shopifyTitle: Already on Shopify? Or want to be?
scale.shopifyText: We build and customise stores on the Shopify platform, so you get a proven shop back end with a front end that looks like your business.

contact.title: Tell us what you need.
contact.intro: Tell us about your business, big or small, and you'll get a reply from a real person, not a ticket number.

form.name: Your name
form.messagePlaceholder: A new site for my bakery, with online orders for local delivery.
form.errMessage: A sentence or two is enough
form.applyNote: Looking to apply for the sales role? Use the LinkedIn posting instead.
form.sentText: One of us will reply personally within one working day.

role.title: Salesperson, small-business websites
role.intro: We're a small company and we say so. That also means your work is visible, your input shapes the offer, and early results count.
role.pitchText: Custom websites for restaurants, clinics, tradespeople, local shops and consultants: businesses with 1 to 20 people that need a serious site and do not want an agency maze. You sell a clear offer: a site, built by the people you introduce them to.
pitchPoints: One point of contact from sale to launch
role.photoAlt: Smiling woman enjoying a video call on her laptop during a remote team meeting

steps.d: We tell you the plan, you tell us how you sell.
Work a small territory, learn the product, see the numbers.

role.ctaText: The full job description and application live on LinkedIn.

form.title: Send us your application
form.intro: Attach your CV as a PDF and tell us a little about yourself. You can also apply through the LinkedIn posting.
